name: muesli
description: Analyze supplied Muesli transcripts, with optional local CLI workflows on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Turn a Muesli transcript you provide into clear notes, decisions, and action items. On a Mac with local command access, the plugin also guides the agent through Muesli's bundled CLI to find meetings and dictations, transcribe local audio, and save notes when requested. ChatGPT cannot directly read files or meetings stored on your Mac through this skills-only plugin; supply the transcript in chat for that workflow.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this Muesli transcript I provided.
Find decisions and action items in this Muesli transcript.
On my Mac, list recent Muesli meetings with the CLI.
